reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the March 31, 2026 independent public accountant certification (Pablo Eduardo Soto, CPA) still reconciles 973,000,960.19 outstanding wARS across Ethereum, World Chain, Base, Polygon, Gnosis, and BNB Smart Chain to ARS 1,036,276,284 of collateral in Argentine bank accounts and financial institutions and certifies that outstanding tokens are fully backed by Argentine-peso deposits. The live Ripio local-stablecoins page restates the same March 31, 2026 figures and links the same certification PDF. The engagement is expressly a certification rather than an audit or review, and institutions and account terms remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of wARS collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Argentine financial institutions, account types, provider allocations, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
